shots.content: Inside a kitchen, a rectangular island stands between a sink counter and a refrigerator, with a window along one side and an aisle along the opposite side. A man in a green shirt sits at the sink-side window stool and proposes a recipe for vegetable stew. A woman in a white shirt sits at the sink-side aisle stool. A woman in a blue shirt sits at the refrigerator-side aisle stool. There is one empty place.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the refrigerator end, looking along the kitchen island toward the sink counter, with both window-side stools and both aisle-side stools and the sink counter in frame.

shots.content: A woman in an orange shirt enters and sits in the empty place. She asks about cutting the vegetables, and a man in a green shirt explains the technique.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side stools.

shots.content: A man in a green shirt insists on minimizing waste when preparing the ingredients.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person at the sink-side window stool.

shots.content: A woman in a blue shirt asks about the revised vegetable preparation plan, and a man in a green shirt replies.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot directly above the kitchen island.
